question: What practice begins first when one engages the root wheel?
premises: The root wheel is the first focus
Practice occurs at a certain time
The beloved is addressed about this stage
inference: When one practices, the root wheel is engaged first.
uncertainties: The fused form yadānyabhyasate is read as yadā abhyasate.
plain_english: O Beloved, when one practices, first it is the root wheel.
